synopsis: ASAM OSI is the message standard published by ASAM for connecting environment, sensor, fusion and function models, including time-stamped ground truth, sensor views, sensor data and detected objects [f13218, f5260, f13219]. The booklet rates OSI as domain-neutral and transferable to off-road work, but stresses that its road-vehicle heritage and cited on-road evidence do not constitute proof for quarry machines [f13224, f5507]. OSI supports portable, sealed sensor-model delivery; recommendations include requesting an OSI/OSMP-packaged FMI 2.0 FMU when suppliers withhold internals and fixing supplier-independent object, warning and brake-request semantics before hardware [f13220, f13221, f4857, f13228]. Existing abstractions leave gaps in camera spectral irradiance, radar raw waveforms and bidirectional sensor–ECU behaviour; ASAM's high-fidelity extension runs from April 2025 to March 2027, overlapping planned first-tool-chain integration and creating versioning risk [f7081, f5093, f13227, f15870, f8619]. ASAM also reports no standardized sensor-simulation quality metrics, with the metrics project still at proposal stage in September 2025; separately, the research did not verify OSI's status [f13225, f13226, f7165].
